L1.proof: One request-to-operation lineage, canonical reason codes, and existing timing/attempt instrumentation.
requirements: Reuse request/operation correlation and execution identity.
Reuse diagnostics, failure codes, source/adapter timing and network-attempt accounting.

L2.policy_owner: Platform L2; no family deletion/retention policy.
L2.proof: Artifact-role/retention evidence and compatibility fixtures or explicit fail-closed result.
requirements: Declare artifact roles and READ_EXISTING/replay/refetch distinction.
Declare replay supported or unsupported; replay is not refetch.
Classify retention, backup relevance, restore compatibility and migration compatibility.

L3.proof: Bounded offline negative fixtures for each applicable drift class and distinct failure/currentness states.
requirements: Network source: transport/status, encoding, parse, schema/field drift, semantic validation, empty response, publication delay, rate limit, removal and contract drift.
Local/derived: mark transport-only dimensions N/A with proof; semantic validation and provenance remain required.

L4.proof: Existing L4 controls/tests at each exercised seam; family-specific bypass is prohibited.
requirements: Loopback/control-plane boundary; path containment; bounded request/output/artifacts.
Hostile source content remains data; secret and dependency boundaries.
Finite external timeout, concurrency, dynamic disk admission and memory policy.

overall: Compatibility/conformance requirement only; no future implementation is accepted by A1.
